topic: From Roots to Chaos: Newton's Method and Fractals

outline.topic: From Roots to Chaos: Newton's Method and Fractals

sections.title: The Quest for the Root (Prerequisites & Intuition)
sections.content: Briefly introduce root-finding: we want to solve f(x)=0. Visualize this as finding where a curve crosses the X-axis. Explain the intuition of Newton's method: 'If you don't know the root, start with a guess, draw a tangent line to the curve at that point, and move to where that tangent hits the X-axis.'
sections.example: A hiker (the point) trying to find the base of a valley (the root) by always walking along the steepest downward slope.

sections.title: The Newton Iteration Formula
sections.content: Introduce the mathematical formula: x_{n+1} = x_n - f(x_n)/f'(x_n). Explain this as a feedback loop. Use a graphical animation where a point jumps closer to the root with every step, demonstrating rapid convergence.
sections.example: A robotic arm adjusting its position based on the sensor error slope until it perfectly grips a bolt.

sections.title: When Convergence Breaks: The Basin of Attraction
sections.content: Explain that Newton's method doesn't always go to the nearest root. Sometimes it enters a chaotic loop or jumps between roots. Define the 'Basin of Attraction': the set of initial guesses that lead to a specific root.
sections.example: Three magnets placed on a table; a metal ball dropped at different spots is pulled to different magnets.

sections.title: The Birth of the Newton Fractal
sections.content: Extend to the complex plane. If we color every starting point based on which root it converges to, the boundaries become infinitely complex. Show a zoom-in animation of the boundary regions to reveal the self-similar fractal patterns.
sections.example: A 'Digital Map' where the borders between different territories (roots) show intricate, repeating snowflake-like patterns regardless of how much you zoom in.

sections.title: Summary and Philosophical Takeaway
sections.content: Conclude that simple deterministic rules (Newton's formula) can generate extreme complexity (Fractals). Reiterate that mathematical beauty often emerges from the limits of iterative processes.
sections.example: A tiny acorn (the formula) growing into a complex, infinite-looking oak tree (the fractal).

storyboard.title: The Quest for the Root (Prerequisites & Intuition)
lecture_lines: We seek roots where a curve crosses zero.
Start with a guess on the curve.
Draw a tangent line at that point.
Follow the tangent down to the axis.
Repeat this to find the root.
animations: Fade in curve f(x) in #FFFFFF, highlight zero-crossing root point in #FF0000.
Place point x_0 on curve, label it in #00FFFF, and mark the position with [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/pencil.svg].
Draw tangent line in #FFFF00 through x_0 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg].
Animate dot along tangent to new intersection x_1.
Loop visual sequence of tangent-to-root steps with diminishing distance.

storyboard.title: The Newton Iteration Formula
lecture_lines: Each step gets closer to zero.
animations: Show formula x_{n+1} = x_n - f(x_n)/f'(x_n) in #FFFFFF.
Animate circular arrow [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/loop.svg] around the formula to indicate feedback.
Show sequence of x_0, x_1, x_2 converging toward target root.

storyboard.title: When Convergence Breaks: The Basin of Attraction
lecture_lines: This forms a basin of attraction.
animations: Show graph where tangent line is horizontal, highlighting instability using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg].
Color different starting points based on final root reached.
Populate the complex plane with colored basins of attraction using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/prism.svg].

storyboard.title: The Birth of the Newton Fractal
lecture_lines: Expand this into the complex plane.
Colors reveal the roots for guesses.
animations: Show complex plane transition with x, y axis grids [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg].
Overlay colored regions mapped to different root values.
Flash boundary between colors to highlight complexity.
Animate zoom into a fractal boundary edge.
Show complex, repeating self-similar patterns emerging [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg].

storyboard.title: Summary and Philosophical Takeaway
animations: Fade in simple iteration equation in #FFFFFF.
Morph equation into an complex fractal image.
Slowly zoom into infinite depth, highlighting repeating patterns.
